verdict.rationale: Docs show full and incremental backups and point-in-time restore from a backup's revision history. This suggests restores the user can run themselves. Community reports that backup and incremental backup were historically gated behind enterprise licensing, which limits founder access without contradicting the capability. missing for 10: evidence of automatic scheduled backups with a visible, configurable schedule; documentation of a self-serve restore workflow in the Cloud console or CLI; independent or hands-on corroboration.
